test_sleep_for: test the grpc_testing strict_real_time sleep_for method to verify it blocks for the specified duration
test_sleep_until: test the grpc_testing strict_fake_time sleep_until method to verify it blocks until the specified timestamp
test_call_in: test the grpc_testing time call_in method to schedule a callback after a delay and verify execution timing
test_call_at: test the grpc_testing time call_at method to schedule a callback at an absolute timestamp and verify execution
test_cancel: test the grpc_testing time future cancel method to verify scheduled callbacks can be cancelled before execution
